title: cerastium alpinum var. beeringianum
intro: Cerastium alpinum var. beeringianum, commonly known as Beering's Mountain Sandwort, is a plant species in the carnation family that is native to mountainous regions. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Beering's Mountain Sandwort include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating minor cuts and skin infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
